Customer
  Id
  Name
  PhoneNr int
  SSNumber int
Rental
  ReceiptId -> Receipt
  TitleCopyId -> TitleCopy
  DateRented date
  ReturnDate date
  Price int
RentalProduct
  Id
  Title
  ReleaseDate date null
  Publisher
  CategoryId -> Category
TitleCopy
  Id
  TitleId int -> RentalProduct
  RentedOut bool
  TypeId int
  PriceId int -> Price
Category
  Id
  Name
  ParentId null -> Category
Receipt
  Id
  CustomerId int -> Customer
  TimeStamp date
Price
  Id
  Price int
SalesProduct
  Id
  Name
  CategoryId -> Category
  Price int
  ReceiptId int -> Receipt
ProductToSale
  SalesProductId -> SalesProduct
  ReceiptId -> Receipt
